messages.subject: Deducer plots auto reordering
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am creating some very simple plots that have code similar to this:

ggplot() +
+ theme_bw(base_size = 16.0) +
+ opts(axis.ticks = theme_blank(),panel.grid.major = theme_line(colour =
'#666666'),panel.grid.minor = theme_line(colour = '#666666')) +
+ geom_point(aes(x = Species,y = Fc),data=Vesp_Loreto_Peru,colour =
'#009933')

I have the data file that was opened sorted and the DF (Data viewer) is
showing the all items are sorted as desired smallest to largest based on
one variable (Fc).

No matter how the data is ordered the plots keep alphabetizing the X
axis data A-Z so the X axis is in alphabetical order not not from
smallest to largest value on Y axis.

How can I tweak this so I can plot the data sorted as I wish?

messages.subject: Re: Deducer plots auto reordering
messages.body_plain:
yes, you can edit the Fc factor levels (see: http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.TheDataViewer) to reflect the order you wish to plot them in. There is a way to do this in the plot builder without changing the factor levels, but it is a bit more involved.

Ian

messages.subject: Question on Deducer linear model
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am running a linear model but for some reason it is not producing expected results.
In the console there is an Error noted, not sure what that may mean as it still seems to work just not the correct results.

Any ideas or changes necessary for a more robust regression welcomed.

Bruce

The data is very simple a list of size measurements and a range of values (Min and Max) for bat calls.
What I need to do is use the model to predict the bat call data based on the size measurement.

species    FA    FCMin    FCMax
Myoalb    35.5    45.7    48.7
Myoata    37
Myoaur    38    34    46.2
Myoaus    38.6    42    46
Myocal    31.8    42.8    56
Myocil    29.7    40    53.5
Myoele    33    63.2    69.9
Myoevo    38.1    33.6    52.6
Myogri    43.3    44    48
Myokea    35.5    58    64
Myolei    32.2    41    54.8
Myoluc    39.5    36.5    46
Myomar    47    40.4    54.8
Myonig    35.5    51.6    55.7
Myooxy    40.5    45.7    47.6
Myorip    35    53.3    57.8
Myosep    35    40    46
Myosim    38
Myosod    38.3    40    43
Myothy    43.5    21    28
Myovol    39    40    44
Myoyum    34    48    60

The Predicted results seem to be much lower than expected, especially when compared to the true values.
Blue values are true and valid, those in pink are not.  So the 2 predicted values  fro the 2 with NAs are not likely accurate or close as well.

This is what I am doing:

Open Deducer…

Add data set as tab or cvs format then assign the opened data DF to Bats  Bats<- df

I goto:

·         Analysis

·         Linear Model

·         Add FC(Min and then again Max) as outcome

·         FA as Factor

·         Click continue

·         Click continue

·         Click EXPORT button on right

·         Check Predicted box

·         Click RUN

Once that is competed and the "Predicted" is added to the DF table I paste this in the console:

model.lm <- lm(formula=FC (Min & Max) ~ FA,data=Bats,na.action=na.omit)

Anova(model.lm,type='II')

summary(model.lm)

tmp<-predict(model.lm,Bats)

Bats[names(tmp),"FCMaxpredicted"]<-tmp

rm('tmp')

rm('model.lm')
